name: tf-lint
description: Denies edits that write an AWS access key, a private key or an API token (GitHub, GitLab, npm, Slack, Anthropic, OpenAI, Stripe live, Google, Azure storage, Supabase), and flags Terraform edits with a hardcoded partition ARN, SSH/RDP open to the world, a KMS key without rotation or a 7-30 day deletion window, or a GovCloud provider without FIPS
